QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: CropType
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Crop grown in the field: it sets the row spacing, the width of the crop rows and the headland.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: Environment
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Open field (GPS and UWB positioning) or greenhouse (UWB only).

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: JobType
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Work done along the rows: it tells the rover which instruments to use.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: WorkSpeed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Speed of the rover along the rows and in the turns.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: RowSpacing
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Distance between the centres of two neighbouring crop rows.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: RowWidth
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Width of the crop band of a row: the wheels must stay out of it.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: RowsPerPass
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Number of crop rows the rover straddles at each pass.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: FirstRowOffset
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Distance of the first crop row from the edge of the field the rows are parallel to.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: Headland
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Space at the ends of the rows, inside the field, where the rover turns without driving over the crop.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: TurnRadius
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Smallest turning radius of the rover (both axles steering).
